### myrtletribe
Myrtletribe Hi I'm Myrtletribe, I got that name from a random elf name generator when I was little. I was born in november 1993. I always loved the idea of having a personal site, so I built one to archive my art, and it snowballed from there. Thanks for visiting :) Read my manifesto on using social media as an art platform if you want to know why I deleted almost all my social media accounts. ~Favourites~ mammal : polarbear, orca, otter, weasel bird : kingfisher, hop, owl colour : green , yellow flower : daffodil, dandelion, orchid music : Enya, Tame Impala, Super Mama Djombo, Joanna Newsom, Kraftwerk, Kate Bush, Gorillaz, Daft Punk, John Maus, Kerala Dust, Stranglers moth : Kentish Glory (
